blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Diocese of Calapan has endorsed the effort to legislate a law against political dynasties through people’s initiative as provided for in the country’s basic charter. This is mirrored by the diocese’s decision to have the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) pastoral statement supporting the People’s Initiative Against Political Dynasty read in all parishes across the province on Sunday, Oct. 4. The call to action urges Filipinos to sign the petition and join the movement to end political dynasties in the country. “Let us sign, work together, and put an end to political dynasties […]...
